children: Eight reported total holdings of approximately $380 million, including $90M indirect OpenAI exposure and nearly 302M WLD tokens.
Eight’s treasury totals ~ $380M as of Sept 16, 2026, comprised of digital assets, private equity and cash.
Holds $90M indirect investment in OpenAI (via SPVs), representing ~24% of treasury assets.
Maintains 301,971,219 WLD (~8.4% of supply), the largest publicly disclosed institutional position.
Holds 16,278 ETH and about $120M in cash and stablecoins within the treasury.
Repurchased over 26M shares this quarter under its $125M share repurchase program.
